newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal to buy Echlin brake business.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal to buy Echlin brake business.

text.p: AlliedSignal Automotive and its global truck partner, Knorr-Bremse AG, said Monday they agreed in principle to buy the heavy-truck air brake systems business of Echlin Inc for undisclosed terms.

AlliedSignal said that along with Eclin's truck brake busines in the United States and Europe, it will also acquire Echlin's U.S.-based commercial vehicle friction materials and aftermarket brake shoe relining operations.
The businesses to be acquired employ about 2,300 people and have sales of about $320 million.
The companies expect the transaction to close in the spring.
AlliedSignal and Knorr-Bremse operate truck air brake joint ventures in North America, South America and Europe with combined 1996 sales of about $800 million.
